# What every database answers about the core fixture schema, canonically.
#
# This is checked in on purpose. A change here is a change in what a consumer
# can rely on across databases, so it belongs in a diff that somebody reads.
#
# Only the portable facts are here. A type spelling, a rendered default and a
# rendered constraint definition are per product and are dropped, and
# canonical.go records every one with the reason. The raw values are asserted
# by each database's own tests.
#
# One section per database, because a database cannot build every object
# another can. Rewrite one with:
#
#	go test -run TestConformance -update ./...
#
# and read the diff.

[arangodb]
table author table
table book table
table region table
table shipment table
column author.author_id ordinal=1 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column author.name ordinal=2 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column author.rating ordinal=3 nullable=true primary_key=false has_default=false
column author.shade ordinal=4 nullable=true primary_key=false has_default=false
column book.author_id ordinal=2 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column book.book_id ordinal=1 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column book.published ordinal=4 nullable=true primary_key=false has_default=false
column book.title ordinal=3 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column region.area ordinal=2 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column region.country ordinal=1 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column shipment.amount ordinal=4 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column shipment.area ordinal=3 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column shipment.country ordinal=2 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
column shipment.shipment_id ordinal=1 nullable=false primary_key=false has_default=false
